integrity: The unrestricted VC proof is constructive; the depth-five adaptive witness is a finite exact certificate with 32 leaves, checked by a separate standard-library program. Neither historical uniqueness nor independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The Littlestone formula is proved only for orders 3 through 6; the amplified family selects one cycle independently within each fixed six-vertex group. The 1997 graph VC-dimension paper was not available for full-text priority comparison.
title: Hamiltonian-cycle edge shattering: exact VC dimension and a first adaptive gap
